day_shape: 99 items: UKMTO reports vessel struck by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz overnight, IDF confirms killing Hamas Northern Gaza Brigade commander Izz al-Din al-Bik in Gaza City, Trump denies offering Iran sanctions relief for nuclear progress, heavy Khamenei/Defa Press Sacred Defence Week cycle.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz vessel incident
threads.summary: IRIB relayed a UKMTO report that a ship transiting the Strait of Hormuz overnight was struck by an unknown projectile and caught fire, while Jerusalem Post said no strikes were confirmed after explosion-like sounds near Iran's Qeshm. Iran's foreign minister Araghchi said conditions for reopening the strait remain unchanged, and speaker Ghalibaf said no regional infrastructure will be safe if Iran's security is not assured.

threads.label: IDF kills Hamas Northern Gaza Brigade commander
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet confirmed killing Hamas Northern Gaza Brigade commander Izz al-Din al-Bik in an overnight strike in Gaza City, along with financial operative Shadi Abu Hasira. Jerusalem Post reported intelligence from a Hamas official arrested earlier in the month was used to assassinate three of Hamas's five Gaza brigade commanders.

threads.label: US-Iran nuclear contacts and denials
threads.summary: Trump denied reports he offered Iran sanctions relief and frozen-funds release in exchange for nuclear progress, while telling reporters US officials had spoken with mediators and would win the Iran war "very soon." Iran International said US-Iran contacts continued through mediators with terms disputed; the Kremlin said it did not want Iran to quit the NPT, and IRGC spokesman Mohebbi called Trump "a big liar" and rejected nuclear-weapons allegations.

threads.label: Sacred Defence Week regime messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office released previously unpublished 1986 letters between the late Ayatollah Khamenei and his son Mojtaba from the Iran-Iraq war front, alongside a Supreme Leader message marking Sacred Defence Week and the anniversary of Hassan Nasrallah's killing. Defa Press and IRIB carried extensive coverage of officials' Sacred Defence commemorations, including a 9,300-student writing campaign for Minab war victims.

threads.label: Rubio meetings on Lebanon and Saudi Arabia
threads.summary: Secretary of State Rubio met Lebanese PM Nawaf Salam in Washington and reaffirmed US support for the Trilateral Framework between Lebanon and Israel, and separately met Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan on regional security including Iran, Gaza, Lebanon and Sudan. The UAE confirmed Netanyahu met President Mohammed bin Zayed with talks focused on Iran and regional challenges.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon IDF activity
threads.summary: The IDF said troops opened fire on two suspects who entered the buffer zone in southern Lebanon, and separately launched an interceptor missile at a suspicious aerial target over an area where troops were operating. The IDF also reported operations in Jalud in the West Bank to disperse Israeli rioters, with three Border Police injured.

threads.label: Iran domestic pressure and sanctions evasion
threads.summary: Iran International reported student protests at Tehran's Allameh Tabataba'i University against compulsory hijab, prison overcrowding and disease, shrinking international air links, and named IRGC intelligence figure Mostafa Ahadi as running an oil-sales corruption network. A US Senate report found Tether's USDT stablecoin has become a "significant financial lifeline" for Iran, and a Caspian Airlines Boeing 737 was seized in Istanbul over a €3m debt.

events.title: Iran’s rial hits another record low under economic and military pressure
events.summary: Iran’s rial fell to another record low on Monday, with the dollar reaching 2.45 million rials as economic and military pressures persisted and efforts took shape for possible new indirect talks with the United States.
